topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Hallmarks Framework
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, outlining the learning outcomes and introducing the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Intracellular Cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in pathways like Wnt and receptor tyrosine kinases drive sustained proliferative signaling and insensitivity to growth inhibitors.

topics.label: Evasion of Terminal Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how cancer cells sustain proliferation by blocking normal cellular differentiation in both hematopoietic and solid epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptotic Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how tumor cells bypass programmed cell death through alterations in p53 and downstream mitochondrial apoptotic regulators.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells overcome telomere-mediated limits on division by activating telomerase and evading stress-induced senescence.

topics.label: Reprogramming of Cellular Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells rewire their metabolic pathways toward aerobic glycolysis and generate oncometabolites that alter gene expression.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic discusses the physiological triggers, regulatory balance, and timing of new blood vessel formation necessary for tumor survival.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Dynamics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the multi-step metastatic cascade, microenvironmental compatibility, and clonal genetics involved in secondary tumor dissemination.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing, summarising the overall concept of cancer hallmarks and concluding the lecture.
